hypothesis: A genuinely dual-stream, per-match quality and bank-aware abstention model can retain the raw DINO anchor while intervening only when TRAIN evidence supports a local relation correction.

streams.memory_mimic: rebuilt per-query candidate banks; <=3 same-category cross-video positives and prefix-union raw hard negatives (top4 per prefix, <=12 union)
streams.legal_fit: direct Phase30 fit records with kind=multi_positive_cross_video; support_track_keys and hard_negative_track_key only

model.per_match_quality: [matched cosine,row gap,col gap,query local consistency,candidate local consistency] -> 32 -> 1 sigmoid
model.bank_context: top1, top2, top1-top2, top1-top3, mean, std, entropy, candidate_count/16

loss.formula: 1.0 task + 1.0 all-negative safety + 0.5 gate BCE + 0.01 residual
loss.safety: for every negative when raw top1 is positive, final margin cannot be below detached raw margin
loss.teacher: raw-wrong and frozen matched-cosine evidence ranks a positive above every negative; raw-correct abstains

selection: lexicographic TRAIN-disjoint: total unsafe, prefix unsafe, legal mAP, legal R1, hard-gap, intervention rate; unsafe checkpoints diagnostic only

gate.p16_substantial_folds: >=3 folds delta R1 >=0.02 and delta mAP >=0.01
